title: Concept: Redirect via Redirect (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, Redirect issues a redirect to a caller-chosen address. Open targets let attackers craft trusted-looking links to hostile sites. The remedy is target validation via Url.IsLocalUrl check.
applicability: csharp request handlers redirecting through Redirect; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Phishing and token theft via trusted-domain links; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when redirects carry tokens.
